supersede.name: Databricks Genie
supersede.description: Domain-specific natural-language data agents in Databricks for governed conversational analytics over curated enterprise data.
supersede.useCase: For data teams that want to configure trusted datasets, business semantics and instructions so users and applications can query enterprise data in natural language.
supersede.reason: The former Databricks Genie product URL now resolves to the current Genie Agents product, and Databricks documentation defines Genie Agents as the domain-specific conversational analytics member of the Genie family.
supersede.userValue: Databricks' governed natural-language analytics agents for querying curated enterprise data, generating SQL and visualizations, and embedding data-question workflows in applications.
